name: A Line Held Tight
source:
Far from earth, your only weapons are your work mechs, your only support your fellow miners. When tensions boil over, will you take a stand?

A Line Held Tight is a dynamic sci-fi visual novel that follows The Canary, a member of a mining colony on a far-off chunk of rock. Out there, cut off from the rest of humanity by a vast expanse of space, a maelstrom of tensions are rising. 

As a strike boils over you’ll help The Canary to decide where their heart and their loyalties lie. A branching narrative weaves its way through the deep tunnels of the mine to meet the characters within it as outside influences make themselves felt. Your choices will have outcomes small, large, and unpredictable. Will you choose to make a stand?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3897300/A_Line_Held_Tight/]Steam[/url]]
